region_scene_page.compact: A clean early pop-rock radio lane built around youthful singers, TV visibility, polished hooks, and romance-first singles.
region_scene_page.standard: After rock and roll's first shock, labels, television, and radio learned to package youth music through approachable stars. Ricky Nelson, Paul Anka, Neil Sedaka, Dion, Brenda Lee, and related figures made rock gestures palatable without fully returning to pre-rock pop manners. The records are lighter than rockabilly and less group-centered than doo-wop: the face, voice, melody, and romantic scenario are the selling points.
